user.title: Spot Forecast
user.description: Forecasts day-ahead electricity prices for the next days. Prices come from Energy-Charts and weather from Open-Meteo; no account or API key is needed.

data_description.zone: Day-ahead market zone whose prices are forecast.

abort.already_configured: This bidding zone is already set up.

data_description.peak_threshold: Wholesale price above which an hour counts as a price peak, in ct/kWh without taxes or grid fees. The default comes from the model's training data.
data_description.backfill_days: How many past days of forecasts are reconstructed on first start so accuracy statistics have history. 0 turns backfill off.

model_outdated.title: Spot Forecast model is outdated
model_outdated.description: The bundled forecast model {version} was trained on data up to {cutoff}, more than 60 days ago. Forecasts get less accurate as the market changes. Update the Spot Forecast integration to get a newer model.
